provider_receipt.summary: Unsupported joined completion. The two dependency close receipts assert only that their leaves were closed; they provide no leaf objectives, implementation summaries, artifacts, or verification evidence sufficient to judge the full approved objective. The parent verification receipt is additionally scoped to a “sole project leaf” and contains evidence only for the attached project contract a94de97f…, while the join depends on a second leaf with contract d59bb85f… and supplies no inspectable evidence for it. Independent source review also found contract-level defects in the attached project: src/lib.rs:13-25 cannot represent the required authority, source_type, owner, privacy, review_required, supersession, or affected-path metadata; src/lib.rs:107-125 ingests every Markdown note as semantic memory without classification or review gating; and src/lib.rs:56-89 serializes each memory record and immediately discards it, providing neither durable storage nor provenance-backed recall. These contradict docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md:23-25,71-94,96-123. No files were modified and no checks were rerun.
